en: A colorized historic postcard view of a large central square surrounded by multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and green shutters. In the middle of the square stands a monumental fountain or statue group on a raised, stepped platform, with people walking and a few carriages or early trams visible. On a wooded hill in the background rises a clock tower with a steep, pointed roof and large clock faces. The printed captions at the top read "Graz." on the left and "Hauptplatz." on the right.
